CustomField.formula: IF(ISBLANK(Log_In_Date_Time__c), "", IF(HOUR(Log_In_Date_Time__c) = 0, "12", IF(HOUR(Log_In_Date_Time__c) <= 12, TEXT(HOUR(Log_In_Date_Time__c)), TEXT(HOUR(Log_In_Date_Time__c) - 12)) ) & ":" & IF(MINUTE(Log_In_Date_Time__c) < 10, "0" & TEXT(MINUTE(Log_In_Date_Time__c)), TEXT(MINUTE(Log_In_Date_Time__c))) & IF(HOUR(Log_In_Date_Time__c) < 12, " AM", " PM") )
CustomField.label: Login Time Formula
